integrity: The theorem is proved analytically from the transportation norm, molecular convex hull, a four-sign-case lower bound, and an explicit norm-one operator. No computational experiment is used as proof, and no independent audit is claimed.
limitations: Finite equilateral metrics over the real scalars only; no claim is made for complex scalars, infinite equilateral metrics, or non-equilateral metrics. A residual originality risk is prior treatment under an unrelated zero-sum hyperplane terminology.
title: Numerical index one half for every finite equilateral Lipschitz-free space
